title: Pentagon records of UFO detections and the DoD's five observables

tellings.quote: well luckily the pentagon has hundreds of instances of optical radar and infrared detections of ufos and from those records the dod has laid out five observable properties that are very consistent among the ufo sightings

plain: The Pentagon is said to hold hundreds of cases where UFOs were picked up by cameras, radar and heat-sensing infrared sensors, and from those records the Department of Defense is said to have set out five "observable" traits that come up again and again. Michels says this himself in an episode with a young physicist, citing the researcher Eric Weinstein, and he does not list the five traits there. He raises it as the starting point for anyone trying to work out how such craft might fly.
